subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should RFC 0009 normatively freeze Hosted Feed v1 now, despite the feedId-binding and account-feed implementations still being open in other repositories?
rationale: The patch is internally coherent, but choosing whether specifications lead the implementations or wait for them is a compatibility and trust-policy decision that cannot be resolved from documentation correctness alone.

options.title: Synchronize before merging
options.body: Keep this PR open until the linked implementations settle, then update and merge the specifications against the final cross-repository contracts.

options.title: Approve spec-first development
options.body: Merge the draft contract now and require the linked implementations to conform exactly, accepting the coordination and migration risk.

recommendation.title: Synchronize before merging
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until the linked implementations settle, then update and merge the specifications against the final cross-repository contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The original RFC history identifies this person as its reviewer and co-author, making them the strongest available contract-review owner beyond the current proposer.
